title: Crux 3 quart air fryer
text: Crux 3 quart air fryer. I purchased one of these for my friend who lives across the country - so we can both "fry" things.  I read a couple other reviews that recommended heating the first few times outside in carport/garage so it can off gas the "new" smell - like overheated plastic.  I took the advice - good advice.  After 2 heats - it was ready to go.  I tried easy first - frozen fries.  360 degrees, for 25 minutes.  I had thought it would be shorter timing - I mean baking in the oven is 15 or 20.  But they are SUPER crispy and delicious.  I am going to try some other things - They suggest spraying oil on things you are going to "air fry" - which is sort of defeating the purpose in my opinion.  It is easy to use and clean.  So, if crispy stuff is high on your list - this one is super easy to use and not super big.  The basket holds several servings - I would say it is best for a household of 1 - 4.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Crux 3QT Digital Air Fryer, Faster Pre-Heat, No-Oil Frying, Fast Healthy Evenly Cooked Meal Every Time, Dishwasher Safe Non Stick Pan and Crisping Tray for Easy Clean Up, Stainless Steel
features: EASY TO USE: Digital control with 30 min auto shut-off and audible tone for hassle-free, easy cooking. Feeds 2-4 people (up to 2.5 pounds of food) in just minutes. Simply fill the cooking pan, set your desired temperature and time, and you’re done!

5-IN-1 MULTI-COOKER: Air Fry, Broil, Bake, Roast or Dehydrate foods for your friends and family. Get creative from breakfast, to lunch, to dinner and desserts. Enjoy your favorite flavorful meals, while reducing your fat intake by cooking a variety of healthy dishes.

FASTER PREHEAT: Using Circular Heat Technology, its 1200 watt stainless steel heating element, this Air Fryer quickly make crispy, evenly cooked meals with faster heat-up and recovery. Satisfy your cravings in less time than the traditional oven method!

FRY BUT MAKE IT HEALTHY: CRUX air fried french fries have 88% less fat and 65% fewer calories than typical fast food restaurants. Ditch the greasy food and unpleasant odors without compromising any crispiness or flavor. “Fast" food favorites without the extra fat or calories.

EASY TO CLEAN: Its PFOA-free Non-Stick cooking pan and crisping tray, are removeable and dishwasher safe for easy and fast cleaning. Specially designed compact size easily fits any kitchen counter to keep your kitchen clutter-free!
description: Air fry your food in style for up to 4 people, with the CRUX 3.0 QT Digital Air Fryer. Designed with an energy efficient stainless steel heating element, the fryer preheats quickly and stays hot to provide crispy, evenly cooked food. Air Fry to reduces fat by up to 88% versus regular deep frying on foods such as your average frozen fries. Relish the ease of cleaning with our dishwasher safe pan and crisping tray that are both PFOA free and no stick which means foods slide right off – Now that’s Air Frying versatility, in style
